characters.name: Maya Fey
characters.description1: My assistant and a disciple in the Kurain Tradition of spirit channeling.

characters.name: Mia Fey
characters.description1: Maya's older sister and my eternal mentor in life and law. Passed away 2 years ago.

characters.name: Godot
characters.description1: A prosecutor who is shrouded in mystery. He seems to know me somehow.

characters.name: Dick Gumshoe
characters.description1: Homicide detective at the local precinct. In charge of the initial investigation.

characters.name: Maggey Byrde
characters.description1: A waitress at Tres Bien. Was found guilty of murder thanks to the phony me.

characters.name: Jean Armstrong
characters.description1: Tres Bien's owner and chef. A witness in the case who is also into aromatherapy.
characters.description2: Tres Bien's owner and chef. Has a long debt and prior convictions for theft.

characters.name: Glen Elg
characters.description1: The victim. Was a programmer. Maggey had apparently never even seen him before.
characters.description2: The victim. Was a programmer. His left eardrum was broken the day before the incident.
characters.description3: The victim. Was a programmer. Wore an HMD over left eye. Left eardrum was ruptured.

characters.name: Victor Kudo
characters.description1: Was in Tres Bien at the time of the incident. Has a thing for waitresses.
characters.description2: Was in Tres Bien at the time of the incident. Called the police by pay phone.

characters.name: Lisa Basil
characters.description1: The CEO of Blue Screens, Inc., and Glen Elg's boss. Absolutely not a robot.

characters.name: Violetta → Viola Cadaverini
characters.description1: Possibly part of the staff at Tender Lender? A thoroughly bitter person.
characters.description2: The granddaughter of crime boss Bruto Cadaverini. A thoroughly bitter person.

characters.name: Furio Tigre
characters.description1: The head of Tender Lender loan company. Also known as "The Tiger".

characters.name: Bruto Cadaverini
characters.description1: The head of the Cadaverini Family crime syndicate. Seems to live for his granddaughter.

evidences.name: Attorney's Badge
evidences.description1: It's my all-important badge. It shows that I am a defense attorney.

evidences.name: Maya's Magatama
evidences.obtained: Received from Maya Fey.  → Found in the Kitchen.
evidences.description1: A present from Maya. It reacts to people who have secrets in their hearts.
evidences.description2: On loan from Maya. Recovered in the kitchen of Tres Bien.

evidences.name: Magazine Clipping
evidences.description1: An article from December 5th. Says I was trounced and my client was found guilty.

evidences.name: Sports Paper
evidences.description1: Dates from December 3rd, the day of the incident. On it is a doodle that said 'MC Bomber' with an arrow pointing to '100,000' that was crossed out. 'Ahahahaha' and a laughing face are written next to it.
evidences.description2: Left by a costumer in Tres Bien on Dec. 3rd.
evidences.description3: Left by the victim. Doodle is in victim's handwriting.

evidences.name: Job Listings
evidences.description1: Picked up from a bench in Vitamin Square. Thrown away by the old man.

evidences.name: Lunch Special
evidences.description1: Tres Bien lunch special. Costs 20 dollars despite how unbelievably bad it tastes.

evidences.name: Small Bottle
evidences.description1: Found in the kitchen. Shape is different from the others bottles. Contents unknown.
evidences.description2: The victim's ear medicine. Found covered in unidentified fingerprints in the kitchen.
evidences.description3: The victim's ear medicine. Covered in Furio Tigre's fingerprints.

evidences.name: Scooter
evidences.description1: Ridden by my phony. The wheel guard is all smashed up.

evidences.name: Jean's Loan Contract
evidences.description1: Jean's debt is half a million dollars. The owner of the loan is Tender Lender.

evidences.name: Victor's Note
evidences.description1: "Convicted before, a wicked man or woman, repeat offender -- Victor Kudo"

evidences.name: Glen's Autopsy Report
evidences.obtained: Submitted as evidence by Detective Gumshoe.
evidences.description1: Died of potassium cyanide poisoning. Time of death was between 1:30 and 2:30 PM.

evidences.name: Tres Bien Floor Plans
evidences.obtained: Submitted as evidence by Detective Gumshoe.
evidences.description1: Blueprints of the crime scene. [caption] The view from the entrance is obstructed and could only see the patio.

evidences.name: Crime Photo
evidences.obtained: Submitted as evidence by Detective Gumshoe.
evidences.description1: A photo of the scene taken from near the kitchen. [caption] Two dining tables are separated by a folding screen. The one closer to the camera is empty. The other one is where the victim collapse on the table. There is an intact vase on each table. A coffee cup is knocked over and the the table cloth is stained by coffee. Near the coffee table are some pieces of papers. No one is sitting across from the victim.

evidences.name: Coffee Cup
evidences.description1: The coffee contained potassium cyanide. Covered in the victim and Maggey's fingerprints.

evidences.name: Victim's Lottery Ticket
evidences.description1: A winning ticket for half a million dollars. Found during a body search of Maggey.

evidences.name: Apron
evidences.description1: Worn by Maggey at the time of the incident. Has small pockets but big stains.

evidences.name: Potassium Cyanide
evidences.description1: A deadly powdery poison. Bears Maggey's fingerprints. Found in her apron pocket.

evidences.name: Victim's Prescription Bag
evidences.obtained: Submitted as evidence during the trial.
evidences.description1: The victim got this from the doctor before going to Tres Bien. The bag is empty.

evidences.name: Victor's Testimony
evidences.description1: "When the incident occurred, I broke the vase at my seat. I'm sorry."

evidences.name: Millionaire Radio Flyer
evidences.description1: Experience the most thrilling ten minutes of your life every Monday at 1:30 PM!

evidences.name: Glen's Calendar
evidences.description1: On Dec. 3rd, the day of the incident, there is a note saying, "Meet with The Tiger".

evidences.name: Losing Horse Racing Tickets
evidences.description1: Horse racing betting tickets. Found in Glen Elg's desk. There's over 500 of them!

evidences.name: Gumshoe's Lunchbox
evidences.description1: A tenderly handmade lunchbox. Fills the stomach with love and plenty of weenies.

evidences.name: MC Bomber
evidences.description1: Found at Tender Lender. A sample disc with the name written in marker.
evidences.description2: Found at Tender Lender. Contains a computer virus program.
evidences.description3: A computer virus made by Glen Elg. Potentially worth million of dollars.

evidences.name: Tres Bien Matches
evidences.description1: Matches used for advertising. Found lying in Tender Lender.

evidences.name: Repair Bill
evidences.description1: A car repair bill for $15,000. Paid by Tigre to the Cadaverini Family.

evidences.name: Paper Badge
evidences.description1: Found at Tender Lender. Made of cardboard and painted to look authentic.

evidences.name: Viola's Medical Papers
evidences.description1: A 1 million dollar bill for cranial surgery. Payment was due last year.

turns.summarizedContext: The suspect Tigre is describing what he saw when he entered the restaurant Tres Bien.
reasoning: Fact 1: The witness claims he saw the victim dead at the table as he entered the restaurant.
Fact 2: The evidence suggests the view between the entrance and the table is obstructed.
Prop 1: If the view is obstructed between two places, then likely one cannot see one from the other.
